sections.title: Leadership: Mindset to Action
sections.description: This course bridges theory and practice to guide you in honing your unique leadership style within your personal and professional context. Rooted in an experiential and application-based approach, the course moves beyond simply understanding leadership theories, emphasizing the importance of acting on them and making them your own. Through discussions, assignments, and reflective exercises, you will deepen your understanding of leadership principles, refine your approach, and articulate your identity as a leader. Whether you are an experienced leader or embarking on your leadership journey, this course integrates a structured framework—Theory, Mindset, Action, Outcome—to support your growth. You will assess and reflect on your leadership mindsets to understand how they influence your actions, identify areas for development, experiment with new approaches, and align your intentions with outcomes. By the end of the course, you will develop a personal leadership narrative that synthesizes your past and present leadership experiences, analyzes your mindset, and outlines a forward-looking plan for growth and impact. This course encourages you to move beyond theoretical understanding to purposeful and context-driven action, empowering you to lead authentically and effectively. Non-Dynamics students: please include a brief job description in your Permissions Request.

sections.title: Leadership: Mindset to Action
sections.description: In this experiential and application course, theory and learning are put to work towards action in consideration of your personal context to hone your leadership style. A framework will be followed: Theory, Mindset, Action, Outcome. Through discussions and assignments, you will strengthen and deepen your knowledge of leadership, develop and refine your leadership style, and better articulate who you are as a leader. Throughout the course, you will assess and reflect on your mindsets to explore how they manifest in your actions, identify areas to explore and develop, determine ways to experiment with and implement new approaches, and reconcile your intent with the outcomes. A personal leadership narrative will be created, incorporating analysis of your past and present leadership mindsets with your plan for moving forward. Theory and practice come together to support you wherever you are on your leadership journey. Non-Dynamics students: please include a brief job description in your Permissions Request.

sections.title: Leadership: Mindset to Action
sections.description: In this experiential course, theory and learning are put to work towards action in consideration of your personal context. We will examine various mindsets for leadership such as systems thinking, appreciative inquiry, servant leadership, feedback, and reflection. Through discussions and assignments, you will strengthen and deepen your knowledge of leadership styles, develop and refine your leadership style, and better articulate who you are as a leader. Throughout the course, you will assess and reflect on your leadership mindsets to explore how those mindsets are manifested in your actions; identify areas to explore and develop; and determine ways to experiment with and implement new approaches. You will reflect upon and reconcile what your leadership mindsets offer with what you do in your actions. A personal leadership narrative will be created, incorporating analysis of your past and present leadership mindsets with your plan for moving forward. Theory and practice unite to support you wherever you are on your leadership journey: whether you are an emerging leader, a new leader, a transitioning leader, or a leader of leaders. Non-Dynamics students: please include a brief job description in your Permissions Request.
